style.vernacular: White City International-Style apartment blocks of 3 to 5 storeys from the 1930s in white or cream render with rounded corner balconies, ribbon windows and thermometer stairwells, mixed with grey post-war concrete blocks (many on pilotis), glass towers in the business districts and Ottoman-era sand-coloured kurkar stone houses in Jaffa. Every flat roof carries solar water heaters and water tanks. Ficus, palm and eucalyptus trees line the streets.
style.ornament: Bauhaus/International-Style rounded balconies and horizontal balcony bands, vertical stairwell glazing, pilotis ground floors, roller shutters (tapuz) and pergolas; Jaffa Ottoman arches and kurkar stone vaults; Jerusalem-stone cladding on public buildings; rooftop solar heaters and water tanks.

sources.what: Tel Aviv White City: over 4,000 International Style buildings (UNESCO 2001), flat roofs, concrete, Jerusalem stone cladding rules, tall towers
